tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /gsung ngag rin po che'i lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don 'grel khog phub rnam 'grel ma lus pa bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa blo gsal yid bde 'byung ba'i dga' tshal zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru buddha dhwa dza ye/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dang dbyer med pa'i rje btsun bla ma 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang rgyal ba mus pa chen po la/ /gus pas btud de gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi /don 'grel khog phub rnam 'grel ma lus pa bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa blo gsal dga' tshal 'di/ /'chad par 'gyur gyis mkha' 'gros skabs phye shig de la 'dir rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang 'di nyid 'chad pa la don gsum ste/ bstan bcos rtsom pa la 'jug pa klad kyi don/ brtsam par bya ba gzhung gi don/ brtsam pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don no/ /dang po la gnyis te/ mchod par brjod pa dang / bshad par dam bca' ba'o/ /dang po ni/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad btud de zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ lam 'bras gsung mdo bri bar bya/ /zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa gzhung gi don la gsum ste/ 'khor 'das thun mong gi lam bstan pa/ 'khor lo 'chams pa 'jig rten pa'i lam bstan pa/ 'khor lo bskor ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bdun te/ snang ba gsum du bstan pa'i lam/ rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam/ tshad ma bzhir bstan pa'i lam/ gdam ngag drug tu bstan pa'i lam/ snyan brgyud bzhir bstan pa'i lam/ rten 'brel lngar bstan pa'i lam/ thabs shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa'i bsrung ba'i bye brag bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ ma dag pa'i snang ba/ nyams kyi snang ba/ dag pa'i snang ba'o/ /dang po la gsum ste/ rten/ rgyu/ ngo bo'o/ /dang po rten ni/

sems can la zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyu ni/ nyon mongs pa la zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa snang ba rang gi ngo bo ni/ ma dag pa'i snang ba zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa nyams kyi snang ba la yang gsum ste/ rten/ rgyu/ ngo bo'o/ /dang po rten ni/ rnal 'byor pa la zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rgyu ni/ ting nge 'dzin la zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa snang ba rang gi ngo bo ni/ nyams kyi snang ba zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa dag pa'i snang ba la yang gsum ste/ rten/ rgyu/ ngo bo'o/ /dang po rten ni/ bde bar gshegs pa la zhes pa nas/ 'khor la zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa rgyu ni/ 'di na med pas gzhung 'khrugs bsdebs nas/ mjug gi phyi nang rten 'brel 'gros bzhi thim pa rnams kyi zhes pa de yar blangs nas bstan to/ /gsum pa snang ba rang gi ngo bo ni/ dag pa'i snang ba zhes pas bstan to/ /spyi don gnyis pa rgyud gsum du bstan pa'i lam la gsum ste/ kun gzhi rgyu rgyud/ lus thabs rgyud/ phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud do/ /dang po kun gzhi rgyu rgyud ni/ kun gzhi zhes pa nas/ rtsa rgyud ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa lus thabs rgyud la/ gzhung tshom bu lngar gnas pa yin te/ thabs rgyud kyi dang po rgyu'i dbang / lam la sogs pa'i chos nyi shu/ dam tshig gi tshogs bstan pa/ nyams na nyams chag bskang ba/ thabs rgyud kyi gtso bo lam dus kyi dbang bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ lus thabs rgyud sogs la zhes pa nas/ rgyu'i dbang zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ lam du bskyed rim zhes pa nas/ bzhis bstan ces pa'i bar gyi bstan/ gsum pa ni/ mnyam gzhag gi dam tshig gi sogs bsrung zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro zhes pa nas/ lngas mnyes pa sogs bya zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ lam gyi thun bzhi la zhes pa nas/ bshad rgyud ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa phyag rgya chen po 'bras bu'i rgyud ni/ phyag rgya chen po zhes pa nas/

thams cad mkhyen to zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don gsum pa tshad ma bzhir bstan pa ni/ tshad ma bzhis 'bras bu gtan la phab nas zhes pas bstan/ spyi don bzhi pa gdam ngag drug tu bstan pa la bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung / bdud rtsi bsten/ la dor/ lta ba'i dug dbyung / bdud rtsi bsten/ la dor ba'o/ /dang po bsam gtan gyi dug dbyung ba ni/ 'gal dus skyon med ces pa nas/ dug dbyung zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa bdud rtsi bsten pa la gsum ste/ ting nge 'dzin ma skyes pa skyed par byed pa'i bdud rtsi lnga/ skyes pa bogs dbyung bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi gcig skyon sel bar byed pa'i bdud rtsi gcig go /dang po ni/ zas/ spyod lam zhes pa nas/ phyag rgya ma bsten zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dwangs ma lnga'i bde ba dang zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ dbang po lnga nyams dang ma bral ba'i bdud rtsi bsten zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa la dor ba la gnyis te/ 'khor ba'i rtsa la la dor ba dang / mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtsa la la dor ba'o/ /dang po ni/ 'khor ba'i rtsa bzhi dang zhes pa nas/ gzhan rnams dang zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sa thog mtha' la re re zhes pa nas/ la dor zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzhi pa lta ba'i dug dbyung ba ni/ 'jug pa sel ba'i lam zhes pa nas/ dug dbyung zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa lta ba'i bdud rtsi bsten pa ni/ rnam shes lngas zhes pa nas/ bdud rtsi bsten zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ drug pa lta ba'i la dor ba ni/ dag pa'i chos rnams zhes pa nas/ la dor zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don lnga pa snyan brgyud bzhir bstan pa ni/ gsang sngags snyan brgyud sogs bzhi ma chad pa/ zhes pas bstan/ spyi don drug pa rten 'brel lngar bstan pa'i lam la bdun te/ rten 'brel sgrig pa'i gzhi gang yin pa/ rten 'brel gyi mtha' gang yin pa/ rten 'brel nyid gang yin pa/ lam bzhi las gang yin pa/

tshad ma bzhi gang yin pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba des mtshon cing mngon du byed pa'i don gang yin pa/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba du zhig gis lam rdzogs par 'gyur ba'o/ /dang po ni/ lus khyad par can la brten nas zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dngos po'i mtha' rten cing 'brel par 'byung zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ gzhan dbang rten 'brel zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ byang chub chen po'i lam zhes pas bstan/ lnga pa ni/ chos thams cad ces pa nas lo rgyus kyi tshad ma zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ drug pa ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dag pas byang chub chen po zhes pas bstan/ bdun pa ni/ rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba lngas lam thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bstan to/ /zhes pas bstan/ spyi don bdun pa bsrung ba sum cur bstan pa'i lam la gsum ste/ thabs kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa la bar chad bzhi la bsrung ba brgyad/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i rnal 'byor pa la bar chad bzhi la bsrung ba brgyad/ thabs shes rab gnyis ka'i rnal 'byor pa la bsrung ba bcu bzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ dad pa brtan pos zhes pa nas/ de kho na nyid rgya mtsho'i don dang ma bral bas bsrung zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ shes rab la phyi'i bdud ces pa nas/ shes pas bsrung zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ grib dang sgrib pa thig le 'dzag pa bsrung / zhes pas bstan/ dang po la/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu/ ting nge 'dzin gyi ngo bo/ ting nge 'dzin gyi phan yon/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i tshul/ de drod gsum kyis bsdus te bstan pa/ khri lugs gsum gyis rgyas par bstan pa ste drug ༈ /spyi don gnyis pa 'khor lo 'chams pa 'jig rten pa'i lam la bdun te/ ting nge 'dzin skye ba'i rgyu mdor bstan pa/ mdor bstan nas rgyas par bshad pa/ re dogs dang bral ba'i lam bstan pa/ sad pa bzhi bstan pa/ dran pa nyer bzhag rgyur bstan pa/

yang dag spong bzhi 'bras bur bstan pa/ de dag gi mjug bsdud bstan pa'o/ /dang po la bdun te/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu tshogs lam phan yon dang bcas te bstan pa/ khams 'du lugs gsum bstan pa/ sems gnas lugs gsum bstan pa/ lung sgo bstun te bstan pa/ de la brten nas skyes pa'i ting nge 'dzin mdor bstan pa/ de drod gsum du bsdus te bstan pa/ khrid lugs kyi sgo nas rgyas par bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ tshogs lam gyi dbye ba dang / gnas skabs 'bras bu'i dbye ba'o/ /dang po ni/ tshogs lam nas zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ tha mal zhes pa nas/ 'bras bu bzhi thob nas zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa khams 'du lugs gsum ni/ khams 'du lugs gsum gyi phyogs med rnams dang zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ rlung sems bdag byin gyis brlabs nas byang chub kyi phyogs pa'i chos sum cu rtsa bdun ltar lam bgrod na zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i rdzu 'phrul zhes pa nas/ rten mnyam du 'dres zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ lnga pa ni/ de la brten nas sems nang du gnas zhes pa nas/ ye shes kyi 'gro ldog byed ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ drug pa ni/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i zhes pa nas/ khams gsum kun tu snang ngo zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bdun pa lam khrid lugs gsum gyi sgo nas rgyas par bstan pa la gsum ste/ rlung gi lam khrid/ khams bdud rtsi'i lam khrid/ rtsa yi ge'i lam khrid pa'o/ /dang po rlung gi lam khrid pa la bzhi ste/ rlung lnga rang gnas su zin pa'i nyams/ 'byung bzhi stobs 'phel ba'i nyams/ 'byung bzhi cha mnyam du zin pa'i nyams/ 'byung chung bcu drug cha mnyam du zin pa'i nyams so/ /dang po ni/ sa chu la thim na smig rgyu zhes pa nas/ nam mkha' sprin med lta bu zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sa chu me rlung dang zhes pa nas/ bya 'byung zhes pa'i bar dang /

'og gi nam mkha' dang mnyam pa dang spu lus bde zhes pa rnams kyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung mnyam rgyu dang / lha mo sna tshogs kyi gar mchod ces pas bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ 'byung bzhi'i rlung sna tshogs dang dri ro zhes pas bstan/ spyi don gnyis pa khams bdud rtsi lam khrid pa la gsum ste/ bdud rtsi lnga cha mnyam du zin pa'i nyams/ bdud rtsi stobs 'phel ba'i nyams/ thig le rgyas pa'i nyams so/ /dang po ni bdud rtsi lnga dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku sogs zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ sihla zhes pa nas/ zla ba zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ rtsa phran rnams su thig phran dang skar ma zhes pas bstan/ spyi don gsum pa rtsa yi ge'i lam khrid pa la gsum ste/ yi ge phal pa'i lam khrid/ bha ga'i yi ge bcu'i lam khrid/ yi ge bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i lam khrid pa'o/ /dang po ni/ rtsa 'dzin sogs su zhes pa nas/ g.yal dang mchi ma zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ lte bar dang por chags zhes pa nas/ khams gsum kun tu snang ngo zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ oṃ las bsam gtan zhes pa nas/ mthong snang brtan no zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don gnyis pa mdor bstan nas rgyas par bshad pa ni/ mdor na rakṣa sogs zhes pa nas/ lnga bcu la gsang zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don gsum pa re dogs dang bral ba'i lam ni/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i zhes pa nas/ ro drong byung rgyal du gtang ngo bskyangs zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don bzhi pa sad pa bzhir bstan pa ni/ shes rab kyi phyogs su lhung ba'i zhes pa nas/ sad pa bzhis bsrung zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don lnga pa dran pa nye bar bzhag rgyur bstan pa ni/ bsgom pa mi 'chor ba'i dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi ni zhes pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin cha mnyam pas zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don drug pa yang dag spong ba bzhi 'bras bur bstan pa ni/

khams 'dus pa tha ma zhes pa nas/ chos rnams kyi nang na mchog go zhes pa'i bar gyi bstan/ spyi don bdun pa de dag gi mjug bsdud bstan pa ni/ de ltar nyams skyon can dang zhes pa nas/ ngo bo/ rang bzhin/ mtshan nyid do/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ spyi don gsum pa 'khor lo bskor ba 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la/ grub mtha' dang po bum dbang gi sa drug la gnyis te/ mthong lam dang po'i rnam par gzhag pa/ sgom lam sa drug gi rnam par gzhag pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyu bstan pa/ rtags bstan pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ mjug bsdud bstan pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis te/ nye rgyu dang / ring rgyu'o/ /nye rgyu la gnyis/ phyi rten 'brel dang / nang rten 'brel lo/ /phyi rten 'brel ni/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i lam la zhes pa nas/ 'brel par 'byung ba'i lam zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ nang rten 'brel ni/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags/ byang chub kyi yan lag bdun zhes pa nas/ lus kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas rtogs pa'i 'gro ldog byed/ ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ ring rgyu'i dbang dang lam ni/ bskyed pa'i rim pa'i lam nas/ lus 'dag par byed pa bum pa'i dbang mthar phyin ces pas bstan/ 'bras bu bstan pa ni/ sprul sku rang bzhin gyis lhun grub thob par byed pa zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa rtags bstan pa la gsum/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags sems la 'char/ nang rtags rlung la 'char/ phyi rtags thig le la 'char ba'o/ /dang po la bzhi/ yon tan brgya phrag bdun pa/ khyad par ba dang po mthong ba'i lam du bzhag pa/ yon tan gyi khyad par gzhan bstan pa/ zag med dga' ba bcu drug las gang yin pa'o/ /dang po ni/ sprul sku'i zhing khams brgya 'gul zhing / nyan zhes pa nas/ ting nge 'dzin brgya la mnyam par 'jog nus zhes pa'i bar dang / 'og gi rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs skad cig las 'byung ba rnams nang gi zhing khams mthong bas so zhes pa rnams kyis bstan/

gnyis pa ni/ rigs drug gi rtsar zhes pa nas/ ngo tsha la skyug bro zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gsum pa ni/ sngon bla mas rgyu dus na zhes pa nas/ 'dod yon sna tshogs mthong bas dgod bro zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bzhi pa ni/ de tsam na liṅga brtan zhes pa nas/ rang gzhan ngo mi shes zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa nang rtags rlung la 'char ba ni/ nang rtags sor gcig 'gag ces pas bstan/ gsum pa phyi rtags thig ler 'char ba ni/ gsang gnas phyed thig les brtan ces pas bstan/ bzhi pa mjug bsdud ni/ mthong lam sa dang po'o zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa sgom lam sa lnga'i rnam par gzhag pa la bzhi ste/ rgyu bstan pa/ rtags bstan pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ mjug bsdud bstan pa'o/ /'bras bu bstan pa ni gong gi gzhung gis bstan la/ rgyu bstan pa la nye rgyu'i phyi rten 'brel ni/ yang sprul sku las dbang bzhi bzhi zhes pas bstan/ nye rgyu'i nang rten 'brel dang / ring rgyu'i dbang lam ni gong gi gzhung gis bstan la/ gnyis pa rtags bstan pa la gsum ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags sems la 'char/ nang rtags rlung la 'char/ phyi rtags thig le la 'char ba'o/ /dang po ni/ sgom lam sa gnyis pa nas sprul sku'i zhing khams stong la sogs pa 'gul ba la zhes pa nas/ 'gro ldog sogs 'gag ces pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ nang rtags rlung sor drug 'gag ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ phyi rtags gsang gnas lte snying thig les brtan zhes pas bstan/ gsum pa 'bras bu bstan ni/ gong gi gzhung gis bstan/ bzhi pa mjug bsdud ni/ bsgom lam sa drug pa'o zhes pas bstan/ gsang dbang gi dbang bzhi pa la yang / rgyu bstan pa/ rtags bstan pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ mjug bsdud bstan pa'o/ /rgyu la gnyis te/ ring rgyu dang / nye rgyu'o/ /ring rgyu la dbang dang / lam gnyis las/ dbang ni/ ngag 'dag par byed pa gsang ba'i dbang mthar phyin zhes pas bstan/ lam ni/

bdag byin gyis brlabs pa'i rim pa'i lam nas zhes pas bstan/ nye rgyu la phyi rten 'brel dang / nang rten 'brel gnyis las/ phyi rten 'brel ni bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du rigs drug gi sa bon mthong sa bon drug las mnga' brnyes zhes pas bstan/ 'bras bu bstan pa ni/ longs sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub thob par byed pa zhes pas bstan/ rtags bstan pa la gsum ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags sems la 'char/ nang rtags rlung la 'char/ phyi rtags thig le la 'char ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags zhes pa nas/ lta stangs rnams la thogs pa med ces pa'i bar dang / sems can rnams kyi skad du chos ston cing / zhes pa nas/ longs sku'i zhing khams dung phyur la sogs pa 'gul ba la sogs pa nus zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa nang rtags rlung la 'char ba ni/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu 'gag ces pas bstan/ gsum pa phyi rtags thig le la 'char ba ni/ phyi rtags mgrin smin thig les brtan zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa mjug bsdud bstan pa ni/ sgom lam sa bcu pa'o/ /zhes pas bstan/ dbang gsum pa'i sa gnyis la yang bzhi ste/ rgyu bstan pa/ rtags bstan pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ mjug bsdud bstan pa'o/ /rgyu la ring rgyu dang / nye rgyu gnyis las/ ring rgyu la dbang dang / lam gnyis las/ dbang ni/ yid 'dag par byed pa zhes pa dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang mthar phyin zhes pas bstan/ lam ni/ dkyil 'khor 'khor lo thabs kyi lam nas zhes pas bstan/ nye rgyu la phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi rten 'brel ni/ yang chos sku las dbang bzhi bzhi zhes pas bstan/ nang rten 'brel ni/ rtsa ba byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor mthong nas zhes pas bstan/ 'bras bu ni/ chos sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub thob par byed pa zhes pas bstan/ rtags bstan pa la gsum ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags sems la 'char/ nang rtags rlung la 'char/ phyi rtags thig le la 'char ba'o/

/dang po ni/ de kho na nyid sems la 'char ba ni/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags stobs lnga dang zhes pa nas/ sngon gyi gnas rjes su dran zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa nang rtags rlung la 'char ba ni/ nang rtags rlung sor bcu gnyis 'gag ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ phyi rtags spyi gtsug hril thig les brtan zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa mjug bsdud ni/ sa bcu gnyis pa'o zhes pas bstan to/ /dbang bzhi pa'i sa phyed la gnyis te/ 'bras bu gnyis kyi dbang du byas nas mdor bstan pa/ 'bras bu gcig gi dbang du byas nas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ rgyu bstan pa/ rtags bstan pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ mjug bsdud bstan pa'o/ /rgyu la ring rgyu dang / nye rgyu gnyis/ ring rgyu la dbang dang / lam gnyis las/ dbang ni/ bzhi pa lus ngag yid kyi dbang mthar phyin zhes pas bstan/ lam ni/ rdo rje rba rlabs kyi lam nas zhes pas bstan/ nye rgyu la phyi nang gnyis las/ phyi rten 'brel/ yang dbang bzhi bzhi/ mthar phyin gyi lam nas zhes pas bstan/ nang rten 'brel ni/ mthar thug rten 'brel gyi thar thug 'dag par byed pa zhes pa dang / srid pa rnam par dag pa'i lam/ zhes pa rnams kyis bstan/ 'bras bu ni/ phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub/ rig ma'i skyes bu/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin gyi lhun grub thob par byed pa/ zhes pa rnams kyis bstan/ rtags bstan pa la gsum ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags sems la 'char/ nang rtags rlung la 'char/ phyi rtags thig le la 'char ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'phags pa'i lam zhes pa nas/ dbang phyug gi don brgyad 'char zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ nang rtags srog rtsol a wa dhu tir 'jug ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ phyi rtags gtsug tor phyed thig les bstan zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa mjug bsdud ni/ sa phyed dang bcu gsum pa'o zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa 'bras bu gcig gi dbang du byas te rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi ste/

rgyu bstan pa/ rtags bstan pa/ 'bras bu bstan pa/ mjug bsdud bstan pa'o/ /rgyu la ring rgyu dang / nye rgyu gnyis/ ring rgyu'i dbang / lam/ nye rgyu'i rten 'brel rnams ni/ gong gi gzhung rnams kyis bstan to/ /nye rgyu'i phyi rten 'brel ni/ bzhi pa yid kyi dbang mthar phyin zhes pas bstan/ 'bras bu ni/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku shin tu rnam par dag pa thob par byed pa 'bras bu mthar phyin zhes pas bstan/ rtags bstan pa la gsum ste/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags sems la 'char/ nang rtags rlung la 'char/ phyi rtags thig le la 'char ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu gcig thob ste zhes pa nas/ bha gar dngos grub len pa'i rten 'brel zhes pa'i bar dang / de kho na nyid kyi rtags 'bras bu longs sku'i zhing khams ma lus pa la sogs pa 'gul ba la sogs pa nus/ zhes pa rnams kyis bstan/ gnyis pa nang rtags ni/ nang rtags srog rtsol a wa dhu tir 'gag ces pas bstan/ gsum pa phyi rtags ni/ phyi rtags gtsug tor hril thig les brtan/ zhes pas bstan/ bzhi pa mjug bsdud ni/ phyi dang nang gi zhes pa nas/ thams cad mkhyen to zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan/ bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sar zhes pa nas/ ye shes snang ba de bzhin no zhes pa'i bar gyis ni/ de dag gzhung nye bar bsdus te bstan pa yin no/ /de rnams kyis rgyas 'bring gsum gyi rgyas pa'i sa khong bcad pa yin la/ 'bring po la ni/ gzhung gi steng du rtogs rgyu med pas logs su shes par bya'o/ /bsdus pa ni/ ngo bo rang bzhin mtshan nyid/ ces pas bstan/ de dag gis lam rgyas 'bring gsum du bstan pa song nas/ lam zab 'bring gsum du bstan pa la gsum ste/ rab lam zab bla ma'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyu/ ngo bo/ phan yon/ bar chad kyi chos bsal ba/ lam gyi mtshams ji ltar non pa'o/ /rnal 'byor/ 'bring dam tshig dang sdom pa'i lam/ tha ma lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa rten 'brel lnga'i lam mo/

/dang po ni/ lam zab bla ma zhes pas bstan/ gnyis pa ni/ dam tshig ces pas bstan/ gsum pa ni/ lus so sor brtags pa'i 'gog pa zhes pas bstan to/ /spyi don gsum pa brtsams pa mthar phyin pa mjug gi don ni/ lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i gdam ngag dang man ngag tu bcas pa rdzogs so/ /sa ma ya pa tha mi thi zhes pas bstan to/ /de yan chad kyis rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don 'grel khog phub ma lus pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig gi rnam 'grel gyi/ /don 'grel khog phub blo gsal dga' tshal 'di/ /shākya'i dge bsnyen sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes byas sbyar/ /thog mar brgyud ldan bla mar man ngag nos/ /bar du khog phub 'di la legs par sbyangs/ /tha mar rnam 'grel bcu gcig la bltas na/ /gsung ngag rin chen don kun rtogs par 'gyur/ /'di sbyar dge bas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /dal 'byor lus thob dkyil 'khor 'khor bzhis mdzes/ /dbang bzhi bsgoms pas sa lam mthar phyin nas/ /sku bzhi'i 'bras bu myur du thob par shog /dran dang yang dag spong ba rdzu 'phrul dang / /dbang po stobs dang byang chub yan lag bdun/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po mngon gyur nas/ /stobs bcu mnga' ba'i go 'phang myur thob shog /byang chub yan lag bdun gyi mthong ba dang / /'phags lam yan lag brgyad kyi sgom pa dang / /snyoms 'jug dgu yi thod rgal mthar phyin te/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang go 'phang myur thob shog /ces gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don 'grel khog phub rnam 'grel ma lus pa bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa blo gsal yid bde 'byung ba'i dga' tshal zhes bya ba 'di ni/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po 'jam pa'i dbyangs bsod nams dbang po dang / rgyal sras sbas pa'i rnal 'byor sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros dang / dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i rigs bdag drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen po rgyal ba mus pa chen po sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/

sprul pa'i sku spyan snga rin po che kun dga'i mtshan can la sogs pa ste/ yongs 'dzin chos bzhin du spyod pa du mas rjes su bzung ba/ sa skya pa shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos/ rje btsun brtse ba chen po kun dga' snying po'i zhal snga nas mdzad pa'i rnam 'grel bcu gcig rjes 'brang dang bcas pa'i gsung rab rgya mtsho lta bu la yun ring mo nas 'dris par byas te/ rang lo nyer bdun lon pa chu mo phag gi lo/ smin drug gi zla ba'i dkar po'i phyogs kyi tshes la/ dpal sa skya'i lha chen rig 'dzin pho brang du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni shab stod pa bkris don grub kyis dad gus chen po'i sgo nas bgyis so/ /'di bgyis dge bas bdag cag dpon slob kyi 'di phyi'i don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub nas sems can ma lus pa dag pa'i zhing du 'dren nus par gyur cig yang smras pa/ de ltar rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi /nyams len thams cad mdor bsdus na/ /snang gsum rgyud gsum gnyis su 'du/ /snang gsum lam gyi gzhi bcas nas/ /nyams len rgyud gsum dag gis shes/ /de'ang stan thog gcig nyid du/ /nyams su len na 'di ltar yin/ /shes bya'i gnas lugs thams cad kyang / /rnal 'byor rang gi sems su bsdu/ /sems nyid spros bral ngang nas ni/ /bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin gsal bar bsgom/ /drod kyi ting 'dzin skyes pa na/ /spyod pas bogs dbyung nye rgyu yis/ /mtshams sbyar sa lam legs bgrod nas/ /mchog gi go 'phang thob par 'gyur/ /zhes kyang shugs 'byung du smras pa'o// //maṅgalaṃ// ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 10 a myes zhabs/ gsung ngag rin po che lam 'bras rtsa ba rdo rje'i tshig rkang gi don 'grel khog phub rnam 'grel/ PAGE \*
